box = solid.box@1(size=[1, 1, 1])
paint = solid.material@1(box, color=[0.8, 0.8, 0.8], roughness=0.6)
cage = poly.from_solid@1(paint)
flat = poly.merge_coplanar@1(cage)
seams = poly.select@1(flat, element="edge", by="sharp", angle=0.5)
uv = poly.unwrap_uv@1(flat, seams, method="angle", rotate=true)
solid = poly.to_solid@1(uv)
pattern = solid.texture@1(solid, program="grain = fbm(scale_x=5, scale_y=5, iterations=3); albedo = colorize(grain, gradient=[0:#24415a, 1:#d7ad68]); roughness = grain; metallic = grain; height = grain; emissive = colorize(grain, gradient=[0:#000000, 1:#ff6a22])")
output textured_box = pattern
